segments.name: vessel operations
segments.description: Charters a fleet of thirteen LNG carriers to customers under time charter contracts, deriving all revenue from vessel operations.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment: vessel operations. The vessel operations segment relates to revenue generated from chartering of vessels to customers.

revenueModel.text: Charterers pay the company hire under time charter contracts, recognized ratably as operating lease revenue, with EU emission allowance values reimbursed by charterers.
revenueModel.evidence: Amounts generated from time charter agreements are recognized ratably over the term of the agreement on a straight-line basis as services are provided.
